description: Groundwater and Soil Moisture Conditions - NASA GRACE Data Assimilation is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Hydrological Sciences Laboratory; National Drought Mitigation Center; University of Nebraska-Lincoln | Center for Advanced Land Management Information Technologies. View and download maps displaying drought indicators and forecasts, based on data from NASA's Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment (GRACE) satellites. The satellite data are integrated with other observations using a sophisticated numerical model of land surface water and energy processes. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
